items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: He and I started music at the same time. And the concert band over at the school, he played the melophon.

ctx.x: I didn't know Chester during that time.

Chester was splendid. Chester Zotus. Chester Zotus. He played a real nice bass. He and Cleo. Remember Cleo? Yeah, Cleo. Cleo got killed. Simon was on that time. I don't remember hearing him. Simon Morales? I heard of him. And Mr. Glenn, I always respect him. He was playing. Melis Raleigh? I don't remember hearing him. There was another youngster, Harmon Mitchell's, I don't know if you remember him or not. He's in California too now. He and I started music at the same time. Yeah, I knew what I remember. He used to…
In those days, did they pick most of the time or did some of them use the bow? How did they do when you were a kid?

items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: Old man Mitchell's and Mr. Glennon. I used to see them quite often.

ctx.x: Well, you knew the fellas during the time of Glennon's time? Well, later than Glennon. Old bass players?

Not personally. I might have seen him, but not to know him. You know what Billy Murray, huh? Billy Murray? No, I heard of him. I never did meet him. Thank you. You can meet him a little more. Old man Mitchell's and Mr. Glennon. I used to see them quite often.
Remember Mr. Kimball. Did you hear him?
